test_title: RRB NTPC CBT 2 (Level-3) Official Paper (Held On: 17 June 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Which of the following is the largest river island in India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Majuli Island.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Majuli means land in the midst of two rivers.**
 
• Majuli river island is** located in the Brahmaputra River in India.**
 
• It is a non-coastal landmass.
 
• It is recognized by the Guinness Book of World Records as the **world's largest inhabited riverine island,** at 880 square kilometres.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Bhavani Island is 133 acres of land** expanse located on River Krishna. 
 
• It is one of the largest river islands of the Krishna river.
 
• **Quibble Island is a river island in the city of Chennai,** Tamil Nadu, India.
 
• It is formed by the encirclement of the Adyar River and one of its tributaries.
 
• **Nongkhnum River Island is the biggest river island in Meghalaya and the second biggest river island in Asia.**
 
• It is located at a distance of about 14 Km from the headquarter of the District, Nongstoin.
